source_text:
7.14
̔Ητοίμασε σκεύη θανάτου, τὰ βέλη αὐτοῦ τοῖς
καιομένοις. Καιόμενοί εἰσιν οἱ τὰ πεπυρωμένα βέλη τοῦ διαβόλου δεχόμενοι.
pass_a_gloss: He-prepared instruments of-death, the arrows of-him for-the ones-burning. Burning are the ones the having-been-set-on-fire arrows of-the devil receiving.
pass_b_english: “He prepared instruments of death, his arrows for those who are burning” (Psalm 7:14).
The burning are those who receive the flaming arrows of the devil (Ephesians 6:16).

choices.why: Dative of the people set on fire, who receive the devil’s flaming arrows. Not ‘for the burning arrows’ as the weapons themselves.

anf_compare.notes: ANF lacks this Greek catena as reading English.
